title: Inducing human retinal pigment epithelium-like cells from somatic tissue.
authors: Woogeng, Ivo Ngundu; Kaczkowski, Bogumil; Abugessaisa, Imad; Hu, Haiming; Tachibana, Akihiro; Sahara, Yoshiki; Hon, Chung-Chau; Hasegawa, Akira; Sakai, Noriko; Nishida, Mitsuhiro; Sanyal, Hashimita; Sho, Junki; Kajita, Keisuke; Kasukawa, Takeya; Takasato, Minoru; Carninci, Piero; Maeda, Akiko; Mandai, Michiko; Arner, Erik; Takahashi, Masayo; Kime, Cody
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录因子过表达诱导成纤维细胞转分化为视网膜色素上皮样细胞，属于细胞重编程与再生医学研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Regenerative medicine relies on basic research outcomes that are only practical when cost effective. The human eyeball requires the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) to interface the neural retina and the choroid at large. Millions of people suffer from age-related macular degeneration (AMD), a blinding multifactor genetic disease among RPE degradation pathologies. Recently, autologous pluripotent stem-cell-derived RPE cells were prohibitively expensive due to time; therefore, we developed a faster reprogramming system. We stably induced RPE-like cells (iRPE) from human fibroblasts (Fibs) by conditional overexpression of both broad plasticity and lineage-specific transcription factors (TFs). iRPE cells displayed critical RPE benchmarks and significant in vivo integration in transplanted retinas. Herein, we detail the iRPE system with comprehensive single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) profiling to interpret and characterize its best cells. We anticipate that our system may enable robust retinal cell induction for basic research and affordable autologous human RPE tissue for regenerative cell therapy.
abstract_zh: 再生医学依赖于基础研究成果，而这些成果只有在成本效益高时才具有实用性。人眼需要视网膜色素上皮（RPE）在大范围内连接神经视网膜和脉络膜。数百万人患有年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD），这是一种在RPE退化病理中常见的致盲性多因素遗传疾病。近期，自体多能干细胞来源的RPE细胞因时间成本过高而难以负担；因此，我们开发了一种更快的重编程系统。通过条件性过表达广泛可塑性和谱系特异性转录因子（TFs），我们稳定地从人成纤维细胞（Fibs）诱导出RPE样细胞（iRPE）。iRPE细胞表现出关键的RPE基准特征，并在移植的视网膜中显示出显著的体内整合。在此，我们详细描述了iRPE系统，并利用全面的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析来解读和表征其最佳细胞。我们预期，我们的系统可能为基础研究提供稳健的视网膜细胞诱导，并为再生细胞治疗提供可负担的自体人RPE组织。
